causal_model.inference: Proof services were created through multiple ad-hoc paths without one admission contract, so provider SUCCESS/public-domain status could be mistaken for hardened WFM hosted proof.
causal_model.why_fail_closed: Railpack plus public credentials does not prove the Dockerfile-only non-root/read-only/identity-wrapper controls are in the execution path; absence of proof is enough to make the service ineligible as security evidence.

prevention.rule: Only public credential-bearing services satisfying hardened builder, source, health, restart and variable-name invariants can count as hosted proof.
prevention.cloud_cleanup: Preserve evidence first. Retire or reconfigure superseded services only through an explicitly authorized Railway change.

metrics.prevention_coverage_change: Adds deterministic admission/lifecycle classification for public proof services instead of trusting provider SUCCESS status.
